scope: All 100 source links were checked using official pages or indexed official content; broken links were researched for replacements. Reviewed means the general offering was checked, not that applications are open or every term is independently verified. Fit, benefits and comparisons are editorial assessments.

status_definitions.reviewed: An official source supports the described offering; see row-specific conditions.
status_definitions.needs_review: Current program details or intake could not be established from accessible official content.
